es: Escribir predicciones sobre la vida diaria con tiempos futuros y distintos grados de seguridad.

teaching.en: In 2035, I will probably be working from home three days a week.
teaching.es: En 2035, probablemente estaré trabajando desde casa tres días a la semana.
teaching.explanationEs: Will + probably + be + gerundio: probable y en curso.
segments: In 2035, I will probably be working
from home three days a week.
teaching.audioText: In 2035, I will probably be working from home three days a week.

teaching.en: I am sure that my daily life will have changed a lot by then.
teaching.es: Estoy seguro de que mi vida diaria habrá cambiado mucho para entonces.
teaching.explanationEs: I am sure that + will have + participio: seguridad alta.
segments: I am sure that my daily life
will have changed a lot by then.
teaching.audioText: I am sure that my daily life will have changed a lot by then.

teaching.en: I will definitely be using a robot in my kitchen.
teaching.es: Sin duda estaré usando un robot en mi cocina.
teaching.explanationEs: Definitely va después de will y antes de be.
teaching.audioText: I will definitely be using a robot in my kitchen.

teaching.en: By 2035, I might have learned to travel without a car.
teaching.es: Para 2035, quizá habré aprendido a viajar sin coche.
teaching.explanationEs: Might have + participio: posible, y ya ocurrido antes de esa fecha.
teaching.audioText: By 2035, I might have learned to travel without a car.

teaching.en: I think health apps will be checking our sleep every night.
teaching.es: Creo que las aplicaciones de salud estarán revisando nuestro sueño cada noche.
teaching.explanationEs: I think + will be + gerundio: opinión sobre algo en curso.

teaching.audioText: I think health apps will be checking our sleep every night.

teaching.en: I am not sure, but I might be living in a different city.
teaching.es: No estoy seguro, pero quizá esté viviendo en otra ciudad.
teaching.explanationEs: Might be + gerundio: posibilidad en curso; I am not sure baja la seguridad.
segments: I am not sure, but I might
be living in a different city.
teaching.audioText: I am not sure, but I might be living in a different city.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase dice que los robots estarán limpiando nuestras calles, probablemente?

choices.text: Robots will probably be cleaning our streets.
Robots will be probably cleaning our streets.
Robots probably will cleaning our streets.

feedback.es: Probably va después de will y antes de be: will probably be working.

hint.es: El adverbio va justo detrás de will.

prompt.es: Completa: «Seguro que para 2035 habré cambiado mis hábitos diarios.»

feedback.es: I am sure that expresa seguridad alta antes de una predicción con will have.

hint.es: Es la palabra que expresa seguridad total.

origin.text: I am ___ that I will have changed my daily habits by 2035.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase expresa una posibilidad, no una certeza?

choices.text: I will definitely be living in a different city.
I might be living in a different city.
I am sure I will be living in a different city.

feedback.es: Might indica solo una posibilidad. Definitely y I am sure expresan certeza.

hint.es: Busca el verbo que solo dice que algo es posible.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Seguramente estaré usando un robot en mi cocina.»

answer.text: I will probably be using a robot in my kitchen

feedback.es: Will probably be using: seguridad media, acción en curso y adverbio tras will.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué tan segura está la persona.

choices.text: It is certain.
It will not happen.
It is only possible.

feedback.es: I am not sure y might indican que solo es una posibilidad.

feedback.es: Definitely va entre will y el verbo y expresa seguridad total.

origin.text: In 2035, I will ___ travel by train every week.

prompt.es: Escribe cómo será tu vida diaria en 2035 (80–100 palabras).

answer.text: In 2035, my daily life will be very different. I will probably be working from home three days a week, and I might be living in a different city. I am sure I will have saved enough money for a long trip, because I will travel more. I will definitely be using a robot in my kitchen, so I will have more time for sport. I am not sure about everything, but I think the future will be good for my daily life.
accepted: In 2035, my daily life will be very different. I will probably be working from home three days a week, and I might be living in a different city. I am sure I will have saved enough money for a long trip, because I will travel more. I will definitely be using a robot in my kitchen, so I will have more time for sport. I am not sure about everything, but I think the future will be good for my daily life.

By 2035, my life will have changed a lot. I will probably be working from home three days a week, and I might be living in another city. I will definitely have saved money for a long trip, and I will be using a robot in my kitchen every day. Some things are not certain, but I think my daily life will be easier, and I will have more time to travel with my family and to do sport.

feedback.es: Una buena predicción combina marco de tiempo, will be / will have y grados de seguridad (probably, might, definitely, I am sure).

origin.text: Datos: trabajarás desde casa tres días a la semana (probable); quizá vivirás en otra ciudad (posible); habrás ahorrado dinero para un viaje largo (seguro); usarás un robot en tu cocina (seguro); al final, di que no estás seguro de todo.

choices.text: She will stay here.

She will have a new job.
